stories.title: US threatens sanctions on countries that don't cut economic ties to Tehran
stories.reason: Iran's Supreme National Security Council has vowed a 'seismic' retaliation, and the sanctions net now extends to China, India, Turkey, Iraq, and the UAE.

stories.title: Fed Chair Powell signals path to rate cuts in Jackson Hole speech
stories.reason: Odds of a September rate cut jumped to near 90% after Powell said the policy stance 'may warrant' adjusting, despite lingering tariff-driven inflation risk.

stories.title: Stock market news for Aug. 24, 2026: chip stocks weigh on Wall Street
stories.reason: Micron, AMD, and Broadcom all fell sharply even as the Dow closed higher, a split reaction ahead of Nvidia's earnings this week.

stories.title: Canadian dollar slides as Ottawa and Washington head for all-out trade war
stories.reason: Carney's retaliatory tariffs on steel, dairy, and electronics take effect September 8, and Canadian small businesses are already bracing for the hit.

stories.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT for Teens with stronger safety protections
stories.reason: The rollout uses automatic age-prediction rather than verification, and child-safety experts are already questioning how reliable that detection is.

stories.title: Anthropic, Macquarie, and GIC launch Theseus Infrastructure for AI data centers
stories.reason: A purpose-built data center platform with Anthropic as anchor tenant, signaling how much capital the AI buildout now requires.

stories.title: Hawk Fire containment reaches 27% as evacuations ease around Reno
stories.reason: Crews stopped the fire short of the Somersett neighborhood and reopened US-395, though a damage assessment already counts 32 homes destroyed.
